Batches, incremental observations and c"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Codex-style Computer Use"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**The most precise way to drive Windows from DeepSeek Harness — and the cheapest per task.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Describe the goal. Your agent reads exact control identities, acts through the controls themselves, "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"verifies the result — and finishes a known sequence in one model round trip instead of ten."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English | 中文 | Français | Deutsch | Español | Português | العربية | Русский | فارسی · Install · Chan"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"gelog · 2.0.0 changes"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why it is the precise one"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Identity, not guesswork.** UI Automation exposes the real control tree with exact `AutomationId`"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"s, and actions can drive a control through its own UI Automation patterns instead of clicking coordi"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"nates.
- **Marks are checked, not trusted.** By default, a numbered mark is validated against window"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" identity and sampled pixels before any input is dispatched, so a stale mark is refused rather than "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"clicked at the wrong place. When an animated neighbour keeps invalidating the pixel signature, `uiaO"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"nly` pins identity to the window handle and geometry while the dispatch-time occlusion check still a"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"pplies.
- **Queries stay bounded.** UIA queries default to depth 6, 120 nodes and a 1200 ms soft bud"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"get; a query deeper than 6 or larger than 300 nodes requires a measured `anchor`, so a query cannot "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"quietly sweep the wrong region.
- **When the app hides it, read it.** `computer_ocr` returns lines a"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"nd per-word boxes in absolute screen pixels, so zero-UIA applications can be located by name."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Why it costs less"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **One round trip for a known sequence.** One `computer_batch` call runs a list of actions serially"},{"id":"p9s2","text":", stops at the first failure, and costs one model round trip instead of one per action.
- **Only the"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" delta comes back.** Pass the previous observation ID as `since` and receive additions, changes, rem"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ovals and ordering — not the whole tree again.
- **Compact receipts by default in 2.0.0.** Post-acti"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"on text normally adds at most 6 KiB to the action receipt; `feedback: full` is still there when deta"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"il matters more.
- **Evidence stays out of the conversation.** Complete point evidence can live in a"},{"id":"p9s7","text":" bounded local cache (4 MiB memory, 32 MiB disk, 64 records, 24-hour expiry) and be pulled on demand"},{"id":"p9s8","text":".
- **Local work stays local.** UI Automation, screen OCR and pixel checks run in the prebuilt nativ"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"e worker — no extra vision bill per step."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Built for a desktop you still use"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **It waits for you.** A 1-second notice before input (0.1 second within a rolling 3-minute window)"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" hands the desktop back immediately; after you finish, the agent re-observes and continues the origi"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"nal task.
- **The brake reaches the model.** `Ctrl+Esc` pauses, `Ctrl+Alt+R` resumes, `Ctrl+Alt+Q` e"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"xits, and a stop is pushed into the running session. Approvals stay on by default and password field"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"s are refused by default.
- **It reports what it cannot do.** The Windows secure desktop (UAC prompt"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" or lock screen) is detected, reported and resumed after — not blind-retried."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The illustrations above show the interaction model introduced in 1.3.0; the 2.0.0 kite pointer, boun"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ded queries and compact receipts are described above. Actual token use depends on the task, model an"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"d observation strategy. Approvals remain enabled by default; explicit pause, cancellation and exit r"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"emain authoritative."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Ready to install.** 19 desktop tools, with native helpers included. No SDK or install-time compila"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"tion. Requires Windows, Node.js ≥ 22 and the .NET Framework 4.x included with Windows. An independen"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"t community plugin; Codex describes the interaction style."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## New in 2.0.0"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Compact receipts by default** — post-action text normally adds at most 6 KiB to the action recei"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"pt; `feedback: full` and `feedback: none` are explicit alternatives.
- **Bounded, anchored UIA queri"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"es** — depth 6, 120 nodes and a 1200 ms soft budget by default; queries deeper than 6 or larger than"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" 300 nodes need a measured `anchor`.
